questions.text: हड़प्पा समाज के भीतर सामाजिक भिन्नताओं का अध्ययन करने के लिए पुरातत्त्वविदों द्वारा उपयोग की जाने वाली प्राथमिक विधि निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सी है ?
questions.text_english: Which of the following is the primary method archaeologists used to study social differences within the Harappan society?

options.B: मुहरों की बनावट का विश्लेषण करना

questions.solution: Archaeologists examine burial customs to understand social differences because the way people were buried often reflected their status and wealth, with some graves containing more elaborate grave goods than others.

questions.text: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सी महाभारत के आख्यान खंडों की विशेषता है ?
questions.text_english: Which of the following is a characteristic of the narrative sections of the Mahabharata?

options.C: इनमें सांस्कृतिक अनुष्ठानों का वर्णन है

questions.solution: The narrative section of the Mahabharata contains stories, which differentiate it from the didactic section, which contains rules and philosophical discussions about social norms.

questions.text: नीचे दो कथन दिए गए हैं, अभिकथन (A) और कारण (R) । इनको ध्यानपूर्वक पढ़िए और सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए : अभिकथन (A): प्राचीन भारत के राजनीतिक इतिहास को समझने के लिए जेम्स प्रिंसेप का कार्य महत्त्वपूर्ण था। कारण (R) : अभिलेखों को समझने से राजनीतिक घटनाओं और शासकों के बारे में जानकारी मिलती है।
questions.text_english: Two statements labelled as Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are given below. Read them carefully and select the correct option: Assertion (A): James Prinsep's work was crucial for understanding the political history of ancient India. Reason (R): Deciphering inscriptions provided insights into political events and rulers.

options.A: अभिकथन (A) और कारण (R) दोनों सही हैं और कारण (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या करता है।
options.B: अभिकथन (A) और कारण (R) दोनों सही हैं, परन्तु कारण (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या नहीं करता है।
options.C: अभिकथन (A) सही है, परन्तु कारण (R) ग़लत है।
options.D: अभिकथन (A) ग़लत है, परन्तु कारण (R) सही है।

options_english.A: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true and Reason (R) is the correct explanation of the Assertion (A).
options_english.B: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true, but Reason (R) is not the correct explanation of the Assertion (A).
options_english.C: Assertion (A) is true, but Reason (R) is false.
options_english.D: Assertion (A) is false, but Reason (R) is true.

questions.solution: James Prinsep deciphered Brahmi and Kharosthi scripts in the 1830s. This allowed historians to read inscriptions from the Mauryan period, which provided critical information about the political rulers and events of ancient India.

questions.text: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा छठी शताब्दी ई.पू. के दौरान प्रत्येक शहर को उसके संचार के प्राथमिक मार्ग से सही ढंग से जोड़ता है ?
questions.text_english: Which one of the following correctly associates a city with its primary route of communication during the sixth century BCE?

options.A: पाटलिपुत्र - समुद्री मार्ग; उज्जयिनी - स्थल मार्ग; पुहार - नदी मार्ग; मथुरा - तटीय मार्ग
options.B: पाटलिपुत्र – नदी मार्ग; उज्जयिनी - स्थल मार्ग; पुहार - तटीय मार्ग; मथुरा - स्थल मार्ग
options.C: पाटलिपुत्र - स्थल मार्ग; उज्जयिनी - तटीय मार्ग; पुहार - नदी मार्ग; मथुरा - समुद्री मार्ग
options.D: पाटलिपुत्र - तटीय मार्ग; उज्जयिनी - स्थल मार्ग; पुहार - तटीय मार्ग; मथुरा - समुद्री मार्ग

options_english.A: Pataliputra - Sea route; Ujjayini - Land route; Puhar - Riverine route; Mathura - Coastal route
options_english.B: Pataliputra - Riverine route; Ujjayini - Land route; Puhar - Coastal route; Mathura - Land route
options_english.C: Pataliputra - Land route; Ujjayini - Coastal route; Puhar - Riverine route; Mathura - Sea route
options_english.D: Pataliputra - Coastal route; Ujjayini - Land route; Puhar - Coastal route; Mathura - Sea route

questions.solution: Historically, Pataliputra was located on river routes, Ujjayini was on major land routes, Puhar was a significant coastal port, and Mathura served as a hub for land routes in northern India.

questions.text: बौद्ध ग्रंथों के संदर्भ में स्तंभ I का मिलान स्तंभ II से कीजिए और सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए : स्तंभ I (बौद्ध ग्रंथ) a. विनय पिटक b. अभिधम्म पिटक c. दीपवंश d. महावंश स्तंभ II (वर्णन) i. मठों के नियमों का संग्रह ii. द्वीप का इतिहास iii. क्षेत्रों का बौद्ध इतिहास iv. दर्शन से जुड़े विषय
questions.text_english: Match Column I with Column II regarding the Buddhist texts and choose the correct option from the following : Column I (Buddhist Text) a. Vinaya Pitaka b. Abhidhamma Pitaka c. Dipavamsa d. Mahavamsa Column II (Description) i. Rules and regulations for monastic order ii. Chronicle of the island iii. Regional histories of Buddha iv. Dealt with philosophical matters
questions.solution: Vinaya Pitaka (a-i) contains monastic rules, Abhidhamma Pitaka (b-iv) deals with philosophy, Dipavamsa (c-ii) is the chronicle of the island, and Mahavamsa (d-iii) contains regional history related to Buddhism.

questions.text: नीचे दी गई जानकारी की सहायता से प्राचीन भारतीय ग्रंथ की पहचान कीजिए : • संस्कृत ग्रंथ जिसका संकलन 200 ई.पू. से 200 ई. के बीच हुआ। • आचार संहिताओं का व्यापक मानदंड तैयार किया गया। • सामाजिक जीवन के विभिन्न पहलुओं पर दिशानिर्देश प्रदान किए गए।
questions.text_english: Identify the ancient Indian text with the help of the following information : • Sanskrit text compiled between c. 200 BCE and 200 CE. • Provided a comprehensive code of laws. • Offered guidelines on various aspects of social life.
questions.solution: The Manusmriti is a legal text compiled between 200 BCE and 200 CE, which laid down comprehensive rules and codes of conduct for different aspects of social life in ancient India.

questions.text: दिए गए चित्र में दिखाई गई बोधिसत्त की मूर्ति निम्नलिखित में से किस कला-शैली से प्रभावित है ?
questions.text_english: The sculpture of the Bodhisatta statue shown in the image below is influenced by which of the following schools of art ?
questions.solution: The statue features distinct Hellenistic influences such as realistic, flowing drapery and facial features, which are characteristic of the Gandhara school of art.

questions.text: निम्नलिखित में से इब्न बतूता और अल-बिरूनी के कार्यों के बीच कौन-सी समानता है ?
questions.text_english: Which of the following is a similarity between the works of Ibn Battuta and Al-Biruni?

options.A: दोनों ने अपनी संस्कृति के प्रसार का लक्ष्य रखा
options.B: दोनों ने ज्ञान की खोज के लिए यात्रा की
options.C: दोनों ने राजनीतिक इतिहास पर ध्यान केंद्रित किया
options.D: दोनों ने स्थानीय रीति-रिवाज़ों की आलोचना की

options_english.A: Both aimed to spread their culture

questions.solution: Both Al-Biruni and Ibn Battuta were scholars who travelled extensively and recorded their observations in detail to share knowledge about the different societies they encountered.

questions.text: अगर आपको अमीर खुसरो पर एक वृत्तचित्र (documentary) बनाना हो, तो कौन-सा पहलू उनके सांस्कृतिक महत्ता को सबसे अच्छा उजागर करेगा ?
questions.text_english: If you were to create a documentary on Amir Khusrau, which aspect would best highlight his cultural significance ?

options.C: उर्दू के विकास में उनका योगदान

options_english.C: His contribution to the development of Urdu
options_english.D: His association with the Delhi Sultanate

questions.solution: Amir Khusrau is best known for blending Persian and Indian cultural elements through his poetry and his contributions to the Sufi music tradition known as Sama.

questions.text: निम्नलिखित में से राजा कृष्णदेव राय द्वारा लिखित एक प्रसिद्ध साहित्यिक कृति कौन-सी है ?
questions.text_english: Which one of the following is a famous literary work authored by Raja Krishnadeva Raya?
questions.solution: Amuktamalyada is a famous work on statecraft and Telugu literature, authored by the Vijayanagara ruler Krishnadeva Raya.

questions.text: यदि आप अकबर के शासन की आर्थिक नीतियों और राजस्व संग्रह विधियों पर शोध कर रहे हैं तो 'आइन-ए-अकबरी' का निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा भाग सबसे अधिक प्रासंगिक जानकारी प्रदान करेगा ?
questions.text_english: If you were researching the economic policies and revenue collection methods of Akbar's reign, which of the following sections of the Ain-i-Akbari would provide the most relevant information?
questions.solution: The Mulk-Abadi section of Ain-i-Akbari contains detailed statistics about the revenue, land classification, and economic policies of Akbar's empire.

questions.text: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा विकल्प भारत में मुगल शासकों के सही कालानुक्रमिक क्रम को दर्शाता है? I. औरंगज़ेब का शासनकाल II. अकबर का शासनकाल III. शाहजहाँ का शासनकाल IV. जहाँगीर का शासनकाल
questions.text_english: Which of the following options represents the correct chronological order of Mughal rulers in India? I. Reign of Aurangzeb II. Reign of Akbar III. Reign of Shah Jahan IV. Reign of Jahangir
questions.solution: The correct chronological order is: II. Akbar (1556–1605), IV. Jahangir (1605–1627), III. Shah Jahan (1628–1658), and I. Aurangzeb (1658–1707).

questions.text: बर्नियर ने मुगल साम्राज्य की तुलना फ्रांसीसी राजतंत्र से की, और विशेष रूप से भारत में निजी संपत्ति अधिकारों की कमी की आलोचना की। यह तुलना बर्नियर के अपने सामाजिक-राजनीतिक संदर्भ को कैसे दर्शाती है ?
questions.text_english: Bernier compared the Mughal Empire to the French monarchy, and particularly criticized the absence of private property rights in India. How does this comparison reflect Bernier's own socio-political context?

options.A: भारतीय शासन में सामंतवाद का समर्थन
options.B: निरंकुशता का समर्थन और भारत की आलोचना
options.C: निजी संपत्ति का समर्थन, भारत को कमतर समझना
options.D: यूरोपीय कानूनी ढाँचों की श्रेष्ठता में विश्वास

options_english.A: Advocacy for feudalism in Indian governance
options_english.B: Support for absolutism and critiquing India
options_english.C: Support of private property, leading to underestimating India
options_english.D: Belief in the superiority of European legal structures

questions.solution: Bernier was a product of European intellectual thought that increasingly valued private property as essential for economic progress. He viewed the lack of such rights in India as a fundamental flaw of the Mughal system.

questions.text: निम्नलिखित में से उचित विकल्प से रिक्त स्थान की पूर्ति कीजिए : जहाँ इतिहासकार विजयनगर साम्राज्य शब्द का प्रयोग करते हैं, वहीं समकालीन लोगों ने उसे कर्नाटक _______की संज्ञा दी।
questions.text_english: Fill in the blank with the appropriate option from the following: While historians use the term Vijayanagara Empire, contemporaries described it as the Karnataka _______.
questions.solution: Contemporaries often referred to the Vijayanagara Empire using the term 'Karnataka Samrajyamu' in the local language, rather than the modern term 'Vijayanagara Empire'.

questions.text: नीचे दो कथन दिए गए हैं, अभिकथन (A) और कारण (R) । इनको ध्यानपूर्वक पढ़िए और सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए : अभिकथन (A) : लॉर्ड वेलेज़्ली द्वारा शुरू की गई सहायक संधि प्रणाली ने भारतीय रियासतों को काफी कमज़ोर कर दिया। कारण (R) : सहायक संधि के तहत भारतीय शासकों ने अपनी सैन्य स्वायत्तता खो दी।
questions.text_english: Two statements labelled as Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are given below. Read them carefully and select the correct option: Assertion (A): The Subsidiary Alliance system introduced by Lord Wellesley, significantly weakened the Indian Princely States. Reason (R): Indian rulers lost their military autonomy under the Subsidiary Alliance.

options.A: अभिकथन (A) और कारण (R) दोनों सही हैं और कारण (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या करता है।
options.B: अभिकथन (A) और कारण (R) दोनों सही हैं, परन्तु कारण (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या नहीं करता है।
options.C: अभिकथन (A) सही है, परन्तु कारण (R) ग़लत है।
options.D: अभिकथन (A) ग़लत है, परन्तु कारण (R) सही है।

options_english.A: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true and Reason (R) is the correct explanation of the Assertion (A).
options_english.B: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true, but Reason (R) is not the correct explanation of the Assertion (A).
options_english.C: Assertion (A) is true, but Reason (R) is false.
options_english.D: Assertion (A) is false, but Reason (R) is true.

questions.solution: The Subsidiary Alliance required Indian rulers to maintain British troops and abandon their own independent military forces, which directly led to the loss of military autonomy and overall weakness of the princely states.

questions.text: दक्कन दंगा आयोग के संदर्भ में कथनों को पढ़िए। निम्नलिखित में से सही विकल्प की पहचान कीजिए। I. बंबई सरकार ने दंगों के कारणों की जाँच के लिए एक जाँच आयोग की स्थापना की। II. 1878 में दक्कन दंगों की रिपोर्ट ब्रिटिश संसद में प्रस्तुत की गई। III. आयोग की रिपोर्ट में केवल प्रत्यक्षदर्शियों से प्राप्त विवरण शामिल था। IV. जाँच प्रक्रिया में रैयतों और साहूकारों के बयान दर्ज किए गए थे।
questions.text_english: Read the statements about the Deccan Riots Commission. Identify which of the following options is correct. I. The Government of Bombay established an enquiry commission to investigate the causes of the riots. II. The Deccan Riots Report was presented to the British Parliament in 1878. III. The Commission's report included only qualitative data from the eyewitnesses. IV. The enquiry process involved recording statements from ryots and sahukars.
questions.solution: The commission was established by the Bombay government (I), presented its report in 1878 (II), and recorded statements from all relevant parties including ryots and sahukars (IV). Statement III is incorrect because the report was not limited only to qualitative data.

questions.text: निम्नलिखित में से उड़ीसा (ओडिशा) से संविधान सभा की महिला सदस्य कौन थी ?
questions.text_english: Who amongst the following was the female member from Orissa (Odisha) in the Constituent Assembly ?
questions.solution: Malati Chowdhury was a notable freedom fighter and a representative from Odisha who served in the Constituent Assembly.

questions.text: संविधान सभा के संदर्भ में निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा जोड़ा सही सुमेलित है ? स्तंभ I (संविधान सभा की समितियाँ) (A) नियम समिति (B) संघ शक्ति समिति (C) संघ संविधान समिति (D) प्रांतीय संविधान समिति स्तंभ II (अध्यक्ष) जवाहरलाल नेहरू, बी.एन. राव, बालकृष्ण शर्मा, वल्लभभाई पटेल
questions.text_english: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched regarding the Constituent Assembly ? Column I (Committees of Constituent Assembly) (A) Rules of Procedure Committee (B) Union Power Committee (C) Union Constitution Committee (D) Provincial Constitution Committee Column II (Presidents) Jawaharlal Nehru, B.N. Rao, Bal Krishna Sharma, Vallabhbhai Patel

options_english.A: Rules of Procedure Committee - Jawaharlal Nehru
options_english.C: Union Constitution Committee - Bal Krishna Sharma

questions.solution: Vallabhbhai Patel correctly headed the Provincial Constitution Committee, while other options are incorrectly matched as Jawaharlal Nehru headed the Union committees.

questions.text: दी गई जानकारी की सहायता से 1905 के भारतीय राष्ट्रीय आंदोलन के नेता की पहचान कीजिए। यह नेता 'लाल-बाल-पाल' नामक तिकड़ी का हिस्सा थे, जो विभिन्न प्रांतों से होने के बावजूद भी उनके अखिल भारतीय चरित्र को दर्शाता था । वे महाराष्ट्र के थे।
questions.text_english: Identify the leader of the Indian National Movement in 1905 with the help of the given information. This leader was a part of the trio known as Lal-Bal-Pal, signifying their all-India character despite being from different provinces. He belonged to Maharashtra.
questions.solution: Bal Gangadhar Tilak was the prominent leader from Maharashtra and a key member of the Lal-Bal-Pal trio (Lala Lajpat Rai, Bal Gangadhar Tilak, and Bipin Chandra Pal).
questions.chapter: Mahatma Gandhi and the Nationalist Movement

questions.text: अंग्रेज़ों की निम्नलिखित में से किस नीति के कारण भारतीय सैनिकों में असंतोष पैदा हुआ, जिसने 1857 के विद्रोह में योगदान दिया ?
questions.text_english: Which one of the following policies by the British led to discontent among Indian soldiers, contributing to the Revolt of 1857?

options.C: चर्बी वाले कारतूसों के साथ एनफील्ड राइफलों का उपयोग

options_english.B: The Doctrine of Lapse of Dalhousie
options_english.C: The use of Enfield Rifles with greased cartridges
options_english.D: The introduction of western education system

questions.solution: The immediate cause for the discontent among soldiers was the introduction of the new Enfield rifles, which required soldiers to bite off cartridges believed to be greased with animal fat, offending their religious sentiments.

questions.text: ब्रिटिश द्वारा बंगाल में लागू किए गए सूर्यास्त कानून में, निर्धारित तिथि को सूर्यास्त से पहले राजस्व का भुगतान न करने का निम्नलिखित में से क्या परिणाम होता था ?
questions.text_english: Which of the following was the consequence of not paying the revenue by sunset on the specified date under the British Sunset Law enacted in Bengal?

options.A: भुगतान अवधि बढ़ा दी जाती थी।
options.B: ज़मींदारी को नीलाम कर दिया जाता था।
options.C: राजस्व की दरों को कम कर दिया जाता था।
options.D: मामलों को उच्च न्यायालय में भेजा जाता था।

options_english.B: The Zamindari was put on auction
options_english.D: The case was referred to the High Court

questions.solution: The Sunset Law stipulated that if the Zamindar failed to pay the fixed revenue by sunset on the designated date, their land (Zamindari) would be auctioned to recover the arrears.

sub_questions.text_english: Describe the processes adopted by V.S. Sukthankar and his team in preparing the critical edition of the Mahabharata.

key_points: Collection of Sanskrit manuscripts from different parts of the country.
Comparison of verses found in all versions to identify common ones.
Publication of verses common to most versions and inclusion of variations in footnotes.

sub_questions.solution: V.S. Sukthankar and his team collected Sanskrit manuscripts of the Mahabharata from all over the country. They compared verses found in all versions to identify commonalities. Finally, they published verses that were found in most versions and recorded the regional variations in extensive footnotes.

sub_questions.text_english: Describe different patterns of marriages that influenced familial relations during the Mahabharata period.

key_points: Polygyny: One man with multiple wives.

sub_questions.solution: During the Mahabharata period, marriages included endogamy (marriage within a clan or caste), exogamy (marriage outside the clan), and polygyny (a man having multiple wives). These patterns maintained family prestige and determined social hierarchy and property inheritance.

questions.text_english: Historians have used a variety of sources to reconstruct the history of the Mauryan Empire. Explain the statement with examples.

key_points: Literary sources like Megasthenes' Indica and Kautilya's Arthashastra.

questions.solution: Historians use diverse sources to study the Mauryan Empire. Archaeological evidence includes stone sculptures and artifacts. Literary sources like Megasthenes' 'Indica' and Kautilya's 'Arthashastra' offer administrative insights. Additionally, Ashoka's edicts inscribed on rocks and pillars provide firsthand information on the emperor's policies and political ideology.

How would the architecture of the platform help you to understand the royal ceremonies ? Explain. OR (b) Imagine exploring the roles of the Rayas and the Nayakas in the Vijayanagara Empire. sub_questions.text_english: Imagine yourself as a historian reconstructing the events that took place on the Mahanavami Dibba. How would the architecture of the platform help you to understand the royal ceremonies ? Explain.

key_points: Platform's height and central location for visibility.
Function for events like Mahanavami rituals.

sub_questions.solution: The Mahanavami Dibba's architecture, including its massive size and raised structure, suggests it served as a vantage point for royalty to witness ceremonies. Its elaborate carvings symbolize kingly power, helping historians understand how rituals were performed to display authority before the public and visitors.

sub_questions.text: कल्पना कीजिए कि आप विजयनगर साम्राज्य में रायों और नायकों की भूमिकाओं का अध्ययन कर रहे हैं। उनकी प्रशासनिक भूमिकाओं ने साम्राज्य की स्थिरता पर क्या प्रभाव डाला ? स्पष्ट कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: Imagine exploring the roles of the Rayas and the Nayakas in the Vijayanagara Empire. How did their administrative roles influence the empire's stability? Explain.

key_points: Nayakas were regional military chiefs under the Rayas.
They maintained order and collected revenue.
Their allegiance helped in regional control but could also pose threats.

sub_questions.solution: The Nayakas were military chiefs who functioned under the authority of the Rayas. They were responsible for maintaining peace, collecting taxes, and providing military support. While this decentralized administration helped manage vast territories, the power of Nayakas sometimes threatened central authority, impacting imperial stability.

questions.text: मुगल शासकों ने राजस्व के लिए कृषि भूमि का वर्गीकरण किस प्रकार किया ? उदाहरणों सहित स्पष्ट कीजिए।
questions.text_english: How did the Mughal rulers classify agricultural land for revenue ? Explain with examples.

key_points: Parauti: Left fallow for a short time.
Banjar: Uncultivated for 5 or more years.

questions.solution: Mughal rulers classified land based on continuity of cultivation for tax assessment. Polaj was land cultivated every year. Parauti was land left uncultivated for a short time to regain fertility. Chachar remained uncultivated for three to four years, and Banjar was land uncultivated for five years or more.

questions.text: बंगाल में इस्तमरारी बंदोबस्त लागू करने में ब्रिटिश सरकार के मुख्य उद्देश्यों का विश्लेषण कीजिए।
questions.text_english: Analyse the main objectives of the British government in implementing the Permanent Settlement in Bengal ?

key_points: Secure a fixed and stable revenue income.
Create a loyal class of landlords (Zamindars).

questions.solution: The British implemented the Permanent Settlement (Istemrari Bandobast) in Bengal primarily to secure a fixed revenue income for the state. They aimed to create a class of loyal Zamindars who would manage the land efficiently and, in return, provide political support and encourage investment in agriculture.

questions.text: संविधान सभा का 'उद्देश्य प्रस्ताव' एक 'स्वतंत्र संप्रभु गणराज्य' के रूप में भारत के दृष्टिकोण को कैसे प्रतिबिंबित करता है ? स्पष्ट कीजिए।

key_points: Declared India as an Independent Sovereign Republic.
Guaranteed justice, equality, and freedom to citizens.

questions.solution: The 'Objectives Resolution' moved by Jawaharlal Nehru set the framework for the Indian Constitution. It declared India as an 'Independent Sovereign Republic' committed to guaranteeing its citizens justice, equality, freedom, and fundamental rights, thereby laying the foundation for a democratic nation built on sovereignty.

questions.text: (क) साँची स्तूप के वास्तुकला ढाँचे में मूर्तिकला के तत्त्वों का कैसे एकीकरण किया गया है ? परख कीजिए। अथवा (ख) पुराणिक हिंदू धर्म और भक्तिमूलक प्रथाओं के बीच संबंध की परख कीजिए।
questions.text_english: (a) Examine how the sculptural elements are integrated within the architectural framework of the Sanchi Stupa. OR (b) Examine the relationship between Puranic Hinduism and devotional practices.

sub_questions.text: साँची स्तूप के वास्तुकला ढाँचे में मूर्तिकला के तत्त्वों का कैसे एकीकरण किया गया है ? परख कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: Examine how the sculptural elements are integrated within the architectural framework of the Sanchi Stupa.

key_points: Integration of symbols like lotus, animals, and human figures.

sub_questions.solution: The Sanchi Stupa is a brilliant example of integrating architecture with sculpture. The four gateways (Toranas) are heavily adorned with intricate carvings depicting scenes from Jataka tales, illustrating the life and teachings of Buddha. These sculptures are not merely decorative but serve as a visual narrative for pilgrims, teaching Buddhist ethics and values. The figures of animals, trees, and humans are expertly blended into the architectural frame, demonstrating how sculptural art was utilized to communicate spiritual stories directly through the physical structure of the stupa, inviting devotees into the Buddhist world.

sub_questions.text: पुराणिक हिंदू धर्म और भक्तिमूलक प्रथाओं के बीच संबंध की परख कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: Examine the relationship between Puranic Hinduism and devotional practices.

key_points: Puranic Hinduism involved worship of deities like Vishnu and Shiva.
Synthesis led to broader social acceptance.

sub_questions.solution: Puranic Hinduism shifted from the earlier Vedic ritual-based religion to the worship of personal deities like Vishnu and Shiva through the Puranic tradition. Bhakti, or personal devotion, became the core of these practices, where the worshipper established a direct emotional link with the deity. This period saw the absorption of many local, rural deities into the broader Puranic framework. This synthesis helped Hinduism grow in popularity as it became more inclusive, welcoming people of different social backgrounds to participate in personal worship rituals rather than just state-sponsored or elite Vedic sacrifices.

questions.text: (क) गुरु नानक देव की शिक्षाओं की विरासत ने सिख धर्म के सिद्धांतों को कैसे प्रभावित किया है ? उदाहरणों सहित स्पष्ट कीजिए। अथवा (ख) कबीरदास की कविताएँ विविध समुदायों के बीच एकता और आध्यात्मिकता की भावना को बढ़ावा देने के लिए एक माध्यम के रूप में कैसे काम करती हैं ? उदाहरणों सहित स्पष्ट कीजिए।
questions.text_english: (a) How has the legacy of Guru Nanak Dev's teachings influenced the principles of Sikhism? Explain with examples. OR (b) How do Kabir Das's poems serve as a medium for fostering a sense of unity and spirituality among the diverse communities? Explain with examples.

sub_questions.text: गुरु नानक देव की शिक्षाओं की विरासत ने सिख धर्म के सिद्धांतों को कैसे प्रभावित किया है ? उदाहरणों सहित स्पष्ट कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: How has the legacy of Guru Nanak Dev's teachings influenced the principles of Sikhism? Explain with examples.

key_points: Focus on simple living and service.

sub_questions.solution: Guru Nanak Dev's teachings emphasized devotion to a formless God (Nirguna Bhakti) and equality among all human beings. He vehemently rejected caste hierarchies and formal ritualism. His legacy is deeply embedded in Sikh principles like community service (Seva), the importance of honest labor, and the institution of Langar (community kitchen), which actively breaks social barriers. By promoting simple living and compassion, Guru Nanak established the moral and spiritual foundation for Sikhism, ensuring that the community remains focused on humility and equality regardless of socio-economic status.

sub_questions.text: कबीरदास की कविताएँ विविध समुदायों के बीच एकता और आध्यात्मिकता की भावना को बढ़ावा देने के लिए एक माध्यम के रूप में कैसे काम करती हैं ? उदाहरणों सहित स्पष्ट कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: How do Kabir Das's poems serve as a medium for fostering a sense of unity and spirituality among the diverse communities? Explain with examples.

key_points: Emphasis on direct union with the divine.

sub_questions.solution: Kabir Das utilized simple, vernacular language to convey profound spiritual truths, making his poetry accessible to people across different castes and religious communities. By critiquing the empty rituals of both Hinduism and Islam, Kabir promoted an inner spirituality that transcends organized religion. His verses, often called 'Dohas', emphasize that true divinity lies within the human heart, not in temples or mosques. This universal message of love and humanity fostered a strong sense of unity among his diverse followers, who viewed his teachings as a common ground for spiritual exploration, successfully bridges cultural and sectarian divides.

questions.text: (क) “गाँधीजी ने ब्रिटिश शासन के विरुद्ध व्यापक असंतोष जुटाने के लिए 'नमक कानून' का इस्तेमाल किया।उचित तर्कों द्वारा कथन की पुष्टि कीजिए। अथवा (ख) “गाँधीजी के नेतृत्व ने असहयोग आंदोलन को आकार देने में महत्त्वपूर्ण भूमिका निभाई ।कथन को न्यायसंगत ठहराइए।
questions.text_english: (a) Gandhiji used the 'Salt Law' to mobilise a wider discontent against British rule. Support the statement with suitable arguments. OR (b) Gandhiji's leadership was instrumental in shaping the Non-Cooperation Movement.Justify the statement.

sub_questions.text: “गाँधीजी ने ब्रिटिश शासन के विरुद्ध व्यापक असंतोष जुटाने के लिए 'नमक कानून' का इस्तेमाल किया।उचित तर्कों द्वारा कथन की पुष्टि कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: Gandhiji used the 'Salt Law' to mobilise a wider discontent against British rule.Support the statement with suitable arguments.

key_points: Breaking the law as a symbol of defiance.
The Dandi March as a mass movement.

sub_questions.solution: Salt was a basic necessity for every person, regardless of caste, creed, or class. By choosing salt as the focal point of his protest, Gandhiji made the anti-colonial struggle inclusive and relatable to the masses. The Dandi March served as a symbolic challenge to the British monopoly on salt, transforming the Salt Satyagraha into a widespread mass movement. It galvanized citizens across India to break the law, effectively exposing the oppressive nature of British governance to international audiences, thus successfully mobilizing a broad and powerful front against colonial rule.

sub_questions.text: “गाँधीजी के नेतृत्व ने असहयोग आंदोलन को आकार देने में महत्त्वपूर्ण भूमिका निभाई ।कथन को न्यायसंगत ठहराइए।
sub_questions.text_english: Gandhiji's leadership was instrumental in shaping the Non-Cooperation Movement.Justify the statement.

key_points: Program of boycotting British goods and institutions.

sub_questions.solution: Gandhiji's leadership transformed the Indian freedom struggle by introducing the concept of Non-Cooperation (Satyagraha) as a moral and political weapon against the British. He structured the movement around the principles of Ahimsa, urging people to boycott British-made goods, courts, and educational institutions while promoting Swadeshi and self-reliance. By bringing together diverse groups—students, peasants, and workers—under one unified agenda, Gandhiji gave the national movement a mass character that it previously lacked. His insistence on discipline and non-violence ensured that the movement remained a potent moral protest that severely shook the foundations of British colonial authority.

questions.text:
हड़प्पा की बस्तियाँ

अब तक भारतीय उपमहाद्वीप में 2000 से अधिक हड़प्पा पुरातात्विक स्थल खोजे जा चुके हैं। अधिकांश स्थल सिंधु और सरस्वती नदी घाटियों के बीच स्थित पाए जाते हैं। लगभग 2/3 बस्तियाँ सरस्वती बेसिन में हैं, जो इसका अत्यधिक महत्त्व दर्शाती हैं। पाँच प्रमुख शहरों की पहचान की गई है। वे हैं – राखीगढ़ी, मोहनजोदड़ो, हड़प्पा, धोलावीरा और गनवेरीवाला। शेष विभिन्न श्रेणियों जैसे क्षेत्रीय केंद्र, कृषि गाँव, बंदरगाह और विनिर्माण केंद्र में हैं।
questions.text_english:
Harappan Settlements

So far, more than 2000 Harappan archaeological sites have been discovered in the Indian sub-continent. Most of the sites are found located between the Indus and the Saraswati River basins. Nearly two-thirds of these settlements are in the Saraswati basin, suggesting its immense importance for the Harappan Civilisation. Among these, five major cities have been identified. These are Rakhigarhi, Mohenjodaro, Harappa, Dholavira and Ganweriwala. The remaining sites come under different categories such as Regional Centres, agricultural villages, ports and manufacturing centres.

sub_questions.text: सरस्वती बेसिन में हड़प्पा बस्तियों की सघनता के महत्त्व की परख कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: Examine the significance of the concentration of Harappan settlements in the Saraswati Basin.

key_points: Reflects the immense importance of the Saraswati basin for the Harappan civilization.

sub_questions.solution: The concentration of settlements in the Saraswati Basin indicates its immense importance as a core region for the Harappan civilization, likely due to favorable agricultural and environmental conditions.

sub_questions.text: हड़प्पा पुरास्थलों के वर्गीकरण के महत्त्व की परख कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: Examine the importance of classifying Harappan sites.

key_points: Helps understand the organizational structure and functional variety of the civilization.

sub_questions.solution: Classifying sites into categories like regional centers, villages, ports, and manufacturing hubs allows historians to understand the economic organization and functional diversity of the Harappan society.

sub_questions.text: हड़प्पा बस्तियों को बनाए रखने में नदियों की भूमिका की परख कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: Examine the role of rivers in sustaining the Harappan settlements.
sub_questions.solution: Rivers played a vital role by providing water necessary for irrigation and large-scale agriculture. They also served as critical arteries for transportation and trade, facilitating the exchange of goods and sustaining the growth of the Harappan urban centers.

questions.text:
घोंसले से निकलता पक्षी

यह रिला से लिया गया एक उद्धरण है :

अपने जन्म स्थान तैंजियर से मेरा प्रस्थान गुरुवार को हुआ... मैं अकेला ही निकल पड़ा, बिना किसी साथी यात्री... या कारवाँ के जिसकी टोली में मैं शामिल हो सकूँ, लेकिन अपने अंदर एक अधिप्रभावी आवेग और इन प्रसिद्ध पुण्यस्थानों को देखने की इच्छा जो लंबे समय से मेरे अंतःकरण में थी, से प्रभावित होकर ।

इसलिए मैंने अपने प्रियजनों को छोड़ जाने के निश्चय को दृढ़ किया और अपने घर को ऐसे ही छोड़ दिया जैसे पक्षी अपने घोंसलों को छोड़ देते हैं... उस समय मेरी उम्र बाईस वर्ष थी।

इब्न बतूता 1354 में घर वापस पहुँचा, अपनी यात्रा आरंभ करने के लगभग तीस वर्ष बाद ।
questions.text_english:
The bird leaves its nest

This is an excerpt from the Rihla :

My departure from Tangier, my birthplace, took place on Thursday... I set out alone, having neither fellow-traveller... nor caravan whose party I might join, but swayed by an overmastering impulse within me and a desire long-cherished in my bosom to visit these illustrious sanctuaries.

So I braced my resolution to quit all my dear ones, female and male, and forsook my home as birds forsake their nests. My age at that time was twenty-two years.

Ibn Battuta returned home in 1354, about 30 years after he had set out.

sub_questions.text: इब्न बतूता के प्रस्थान के संदर्भ में पक्षी के घोंसला छोड़ने के प्रतीकवाद का विश्लेषण कीजिए

questions.text:
1857 के दो विद्रोही

शाह मल

शाह मल उत्तर प्रदेश के बड़ौत परगना के एक बड़े गाँव के रहने वाले थे। वह एक जाट कुटुम्ब से संबंध रखते थे जो चौरासी देस (चौरासी गाँव) में फैला हुआ था। इस इलाके की ज़मीन सिंचाई की सुविधाओं से लैस और उपजाऊ थी। यहाँ कि मिट्टी काली नम थी। बहुत सारे ग्रामीण संपन्न थे और लोग ब्रिटिश भूराजस्व व्यवस्था को दमनकारी मानते थे : लगान की दर ज़्यादा और वसूली सख़्त थी। नतीजा यह था कि किसानों की ज़मीन बाहरी लोगों के हाथ में जा रही थी। इलाक़े में आने वाले व्यापारी और महाजन ज़मीन पर क़ब्ज़ा करते जा रहे थे।

शाह मल ने चौरासी देस के मुखियाओं और काश्तकारों को संगठित किया। इसके लिए उन्होंने रात के साए में गाँव-गाँव जाकर बात की और लोगों को अंग्रेज़ों के ख़िलाफ़ विद्रोह के लिए तैयार किया। बहुत सारे दूसरे स्थानों की तरह यहाँ भी अंग्रेज़ों के ख़िलाफ़ आंदोलन एक व्यापक विद्रोह में तब्दील हो गया। अब विरोध उत्पीड़न और अन्याय के तमाम चिह्नों के ख़िलाफ़ होने लगा। किसान अपने खेत छोड़कर निकल पड़े और महाजनों व व्यापारियों के घर-बार लूटने लगे। बेदख़ल भूस्वामियों ने छिन चुकी ज़मीनों पर दोबारा क़ब्ज़ा कर लिया।

शाह मल के आदमियों ने सरकारी इमारतों पर हमला किया, नदी का पुल ध्वस्त कर दिया और पक्की सड़कों को खोद डाला। इसकी एक वजह यह थी कि वे सरकारी फ़ौजों का रास्ता रोकना चाहते थे। दूसरी वजह यह थी कि पुलों और सड़कों को ब्रिटिश शासन का प्रतीक माना जाता था। उन्होंने दिल्ली में विद्रोह करने वाले सिपाहियों को रसद पहुँचाई और ब्रिटिश हेडक्वार्टर व मेरठ के बीच तमाम सरकारी संचार बंद कर दिया। स्थानीय स्तर पर राजा कहलाने वाले शाह मल ने एक अंग्रेज़ अफ़सर के बंगले में डेरा डाला, उसे न्याय भवन का नाम दिया और वहीं से झगड़ों और विवादों का फ़ैसला करने लगे। उन्होंने गुप्तचरी का भी हैरतअंगेज़ नेटवर्क स्थापित कर लिया था। कुछ समय के लिए लोगों को लगा कि फ़िरंगी राज ख़त्म हो चुका है और उनका राज आ गया है। जुलाई 1857 में शाह मल को युद्ध में मार दिया गया।
questions.text_english:
Two rebels of 1857

Shah Mal

Shah Mal lived in a large village in pargana Barout in Uttar Pradesh. He belonged to a clan of Jat cultivators whose kinship ties extended over chaurasee des (eighty-four villages). The lands in the region were irrigated and fertile, with rich dark loam soil. Many of the villagers were prosperous and saw the British land revenue system as oppressive: the revenue demand was high and its collection inflexible. Consequently cultivators were losing land to outsiders, to traders and moneylenders who were coming into the area.

Shah Mal mobilised the headmen and cultivators of chaurasee des, moving at night from village to village, urging people to rebel against the British. As in many other places, the revolt against the British turned into a general rebellion against all signs of oppression and injustice. Cultivators left their fields and plundered the houses of moneylenders and traders. Displaced proprietors took possession of the lands they had lost.

Shah Mal's men attacked government buildings, destroyed the bridge over the river, and dug up metalled roads partly to prevent government forces from coming into the area, and partly because bridges and roads were seen as symbols of British rule. They sent supplies to the sepoys who had mutinied in Delhi and stopped all official communication between British headquarters and Meerut. Locally acknowledged as the Raja, Shah Mal took over the bungalow of an English officer, turned it into a hall of justice, settling disputes and dispensing judgments. He also set up an amazingly effective network of intelligence. For a period the people of the area felt that firangi raj was over, and their raj had come. Shah Mal was killed in battle in July 1857.

sub_questions.text: शाह मल के नेतृत्व ने विद्रोह के प्रसार में कैसे योगदान दिया ?
sub_questions.text_english: How did Shah Mal's leadership contribute to the spread of the rebellion?

key_points: Urged people to rebel at night.

sub_questions.solution: Shah Mal contributed to the spread of the rebellion by actively organizing the headmen and cultivators of the 'chaurasee des' and moving from village to village at night to convince people to rebel against the British.

sub_questions.text: शाह मल के नेतृत्व में विद्रोह ने अंग्रेज़ी सत्ता को किस प्रकार चुनौती दी ?
sub_questions.text_english: How did the rebellion led by Shah Mal challenge the authority of the British?
sub_questions.solution: Shah Mal challenged British authority by attacking government buildings, destroying infrastructure like bridges and roads (symbols of colonial rule), cutting communication lines between Meerut and headquarters, and providing essential supplies to mutinying sepoys in Delhi.

sub_questions.text: शाह मल द्वारा 'न्याय भवन' की स्थापना उनके शासन के दृष्टिकोण को कैसे दर्शाती है ?
sub_questions.text_english: How does Shah Mal's establishment of a hall of justice reflect his vision of governance ?

key_points: Aimed to replace colonial administration with local self-rule.
Symbolized popular belief that 'Firangi raj' had ended.

sub_questions.solution: By establishing a 'hall of justice' in an English officer's bungalow, Shah Mal aimed to replace the oppressive British administration with local self-rule. This gesture reflected his vision of establishing an alternative, indigenous government where the common people believed that British rule had been successfully overthrown.
